_comment: Projects section, in display order. Mirrors the résumé. 'repo' (owner/name) links a card to GitHub so it picks up the repo image, language & stars; pinned repos not listed here are appended automatically after these. 'bullets' may contain <strong>. 'image' is an optional local path that overrides the first image in the repo README. 'tech' entries matching a skill in content/skills.json make the card filterable by that skill.

projects.name: Encyclopedia AI
bullets: Automated article writing with a 9-stage multi-agent Go pipeline (intake, outline, section drafting, evaluate, compare, plan, revise, metadata) that critiques and revises its own output.
Kept long reasoning runs reliable with a provider layer for Ollama and OpenAI-compatible APIs, structured-output repair and retries, and resumable SQLite-backed jobs streamed over SSE.

projects.name: SINEBot
bullets: Discord bot for UCF's Society of Innovation and Neurodiversity in Engineering, used daily by about a dozen members on each of 2 servers, built around a plugin registry of daily games with Chart.js analytics.
Increased engagement and retention by shipping leaderboards, trend graphs, and distributions based on user feedback.

projects.name: TripTastic
bullets: Ended manual FTP re-uploads for a team of 6 by automating DigitalOcean deploys with a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline and PR integration tests.
Set up the repo, MongoDB database, JWT auth, and bcrypt password hashing for a React/TypeScript web app.

projects.name: Drone Route Optimizer
bullets: Routed a drone across a graph of 2,500+ nodes for NextEra Energy's KnightHacks VIII challenge, designing the routing algorithm with VRP heuristics and OR-Tools.

projects.name: GPT-1 Language Model
bullets: Generated Shakespeare-style prose over a 1,000-token context window by pre-training a GPT-1-like transformer in PyTorch with scaled residual projections and checkpointing.

projects.name: A Frail Qubit
bullets: A story-based puzzle game with over 60 handcrafted levels. I built all the mechanics, narrative, and pixel art solo in Godot.

projects.name: The New Order: Last Days of Europe
bullets: Coordinated a fully remote team of 50+ volunteers behind a total-overhaul mod with 500,000+ players.
Onboarded over a dozen volunteers with the Git guide I wrote, while implementing event chains, GUIs, and content.
